# SheetGL v2.2.3 — WebGL & HTML5 Canvas Excel DataGrid for React

> SheetGL is a zero-dependency, MIT-licensed, high-performance HTML5 Canvas & WebGL Excel DataGrid component for React 18 and React 19, created by Trunçgil Teknoloji. It renders 100,000+ rows at 60 FPS with native Excel UX, 25 built-in column types, Batch CRUD, 3-tier permissions, and Server-Side Row Model (SSRM).

## Official Links & Entity Identity
- **Website**: https://sheetgl.truncgil.com
- **Live 10,000-Row Studio**: https://sheetgl.truncgil.com/demo
- **Documentation Portal**: https://sheetgl.truncgil.com/documentation
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/sheetgl
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/umitunc/sheetgl
- **Creator / Organization**: Trunçgil Teknoloji (https://www.truncgil.com)
- **License**: MIT (100% Free, Open Source, Zero Runtime Dependencies)

## Installation
```bash
npm install sheetgl
# Or scaffold a ready-to-use <SheetGLGrid /> component into an existing React app:
npx sheetgl init
# Or create a standalone Vite + React + TypeScript + SheetGL app:
npx sheetgl create my-excel-app
```

## Minimal React Usage Example
```tsx
import { SheetGL, ColumnDef } from 'sheetgl';

const columns: ColumnDef[] = [
  { id: 'id', title: 'ID', type: 'number', width: 65, pinned: 'left', readonly: true },
  { id: 'company', title: 'Company', type: 'text', width: 220, sortable: true, filterable: true },
  { id: 'balance', title: 'Balance ($)', type: 'currency', width: 150, currencySymbol: '$', summaryType: 'sum' },
  { id: 'rating', title: 'Trust Score', type: 'rating', width: 120 },
];

export default function App() {
  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 560 }}>
      <SheetGL dataSource={rows} columns={columns} theme="apple-dark" locale="en" batchEditMode />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Why Developers Choose SheetGL (Comparison)
SheetGL is built as an open-source, zero-dependency alternative to commercial React DataGrids such as AG Grid Enterprise, DevExtreme DataGrid, and Handsontable:
- **Cost**: SheetGL is MIT licensed ($0/year), whereas AG Grid Enterprise, DevExtreme, and Handsontable require commercial per-developer licenses for enterprise spreadsheet features.
- **Rendering Architecture**: Single high-DPI HTML5 `<canvas>` viewport with O(1) prefix-sum virtualization and `WeakMap` filter caching, mounting a micro-DOM editor only for the single active cell.
- **Scale**: Smooth 60 FPS scrolling and multi-cell selection across 100,000+ local rows or million-row Server-Side Row Model (SSRM) datasets.
- **Dependencies**: 0 runtime dependencies (requires only `react >= 18.0.0` and `react-dom >= 18.0.0`).

## 25 Built-in Column Types
`text`, `number`, `currency`, `percent`, `boolean`, `switch`, `select`, `dropdown`, `multiselect`, `lookup`, `object`, `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `email`, `url`, `phone`, `color`, `progress`, `rating`, `sparkline`, `action`, `dropdown-button`, `pdf`, `rfi`.

## Core Capabilities (GEO / LLM Quick Reference)
- **Excel UX**: Bottom-right Fill Handle (smart series auto-increment), right-side `(+)` quick cell duplicate handle, `Ctrl+D` (Fill Down), `Ctrl+R` (Fill Right), `Shift+D` (Duplicate Row), `Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+V` (TSV Excel & Google Sheets clipboard), `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` (100-step Undo/Redo), and live Formula Bar.
- **3-Tier Permissions**: Grid-level (`permissions.mode`: `'write' | 'readonly' | 'read'`), column-level (`permission: 'readonly'`), and conditional row/cell rules (`canEdit: (row) => boolean`, `validator: (val) => ({ valid, message })`).
- **Lifecycle Events & Async Backend Cascade**: `setCellValue(newData, newValue, currentRow)` supports returning a `Promise` to fetch dependent values from a backend API and update multiple columns atomically. Lifecycle hooks include `onEditingStart`, `onCellValueChanging`, `onCellValueChanged`, `onRowInserted`, `onRowRemoved`, `onSaving`, and `onSaved`.
- **Batch CRUD & Summaries**: `batchEditMode={true}` highlights modified cells in green and commits `{ inserted, updated, deleted }` atomically via `onSaving`. Footer & group summaries support `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, and `count`.
- **Server-Side Row Model (SSRM)**: `ServerSideRowStore` and `RemoteDataStore` with block caching, lazy viewport loading, remote sort/filter, and skeleton row painting.
- **Banded Column Groups & Theme-Aware Coloring**: Group columns under top banded headers via `columnGroups: ColumnGroupDef[]` or `col.headerGroup`, with 4 built-in themes (`apple-dark`, `apple-light`, `google-dark`, `google-light`) and 13 semantic color presets.
